subtitle.en_US: Waiting for trees? Far too slow!

text.zh_CN:
普通的骨粉对宏伟之木和银树的树苗毫无作用，它们吸收的是灵气而不是养分。
把骨粉和花朵一起注入大地的力量，就能得到魔法骨粉。对宏伟之木树苗或银树树苗使用，就有机会让它们立刻长成大树。
别忘了给大树留出足够的空间，否则树苗是长不起来的。
text.en_US:
Ordinary bone meal does nothing for greatwood and silverwood saplings; they feed on vis rather than nutrients.
Infusing bone meal and flowers with the power of earth yields magic bone meal. Use it on a greatwood or silverwood sapling for a chance to grow it into a full tree at once.
Leave the tree enough room, or the sapling will not grow.
